e3_definition.first_evaluation: including discovery if all evidence already present; no synthetic tick
e3_definition.trigger: frozen original breakout level; other strategies freeze last completed directional high/low at discovery
e3_definition.condition: real observed quote strictly crosses frozen trigger; current structure intact; all post-watch closed bars including first retain original stop; retain every existing cost/RR/context/RSI/structure/quote/chase/TTL/cooldown check
e3_definition.age_argument: actual observation minus watch timestamp; never spoof 30s
e3_definition.bar_availability: original nominal+0/15s scenarios; actual receipts remain null
e3_definition.same_observation_confirmation: permitted only after full second-stage checks; no claim of separate independent market evidence

frozen.target_policy: P1 byte-identical; no synthesized extension or threshold lowering
frozen.fees_and_risk: existing retained model, same in both arms per scenario

required_outputs: per-event first-candidate and confirmation lead, matching/excluded/added/unmatched
fixed model outcomes, horizons, same-event 30/60s manual delay
baseline full economic window outputs equal saved results
inference: Previously reused development data; all32 arms and16 paired E5 effects. No tuning, selection, new profit threshold, or100paper/30day prerequisites.

e1_definition.detector: Reuse lbank_entry_location.first_retests unchanged, merge only missing (strategy,direction) proposals ahead of capture fallback. Native bars and current real quote; no fake completed bar.
e1_definition.isolation: Do not enable location mode; keep capture candidate/confirmation/target barrier exceptions and chase checks. E4 and location confirmation progress remain excluded.
e1_definition.thresholds: PR21 first_retests byte-identical: 10-bar break, 0.5 ATR impulse/retest lower bound, 0.25 ATR upper bound, <=3 subsequent bars, 1.5 ATR resumption limit; no tuning.
e1_definition.event_matching: existing source-anchored canonical structure identity; no proximity/time matching
e1_definition.target_freeze: target algorithms, RR, costs, risk frozen per panel; discovery-dependent actual plans preserved; shared earliest observed S/T fixed separately for timing attribution

e4_definition.chase: Reuse PR21 location_check unchanged at calculate_plan only, each candidate and confirmation. Breakout: directional anchor distance (0,1.5] native ATR1; trend_retest (0,2]; range_rebound unchanged. Existing capture EMA, +/-0.1% watch quote chase, TTL and all other gates retained.
e4_definition.nearby_barrier: During plan calculation only set ranked may_override_single_pivots=False. Known unbreached conflict cannot be overridden by aligned15m/5m. Preserve original target-room algorithm and buffer; unknown barrier remains original behavior per target panel (P1 room_unknown already rejects).
e4_definition.first_retest: E1 only: retain original PR21 frozen first-retest proof for location validation at confirmation; no extra detector or momentum bypass.
e4_definition.isolation: No location mode, new confirmation progress, fixed wait removal, detector, RSI/context/risk/target/RR/cost change. E3 only in declared E3 arms. No production call or env activation.
e4_definition.volatility: PR21 location_check current native ATR1 unchanged; paired-entry attribution uses common original discovery ATR separately; not a new tune.
e4_definition.failure_recording: Actual gate execution logs and E4 evidence per evaluation. No invented failure reasons for not-evaluated gates.

e5_definition.detector: For each direction use10 completed 1m bars preceding a sweep as already observed support=min low/resistance=max high; exact original extreme source anchor. Sweep strictly beyond that level in latest3 completed bars; first reclaim closes directionally beyond level and prior close with directional body. First reclaim must occur within those3 bars; all subsequent closes retain level. Freeze opposite reclaim high/low; only real observed quote strictly breaks it. No synthetic candle, final pivot hindsight or macro trend prerequisite.
e5_definition.invalidation: Freeze sweep-through-first-reclaim extreme, first reclaim trigger and3-minute expiry from sweep end. Reject quote touching original extreme, later completed close losing reclaimed level or later post-reclaim bar touching original stop. Same event invalidation sticky across proposed watches; no recovery rearm. Existing plan stop buffer/floor, hard data/risk/cost, price deviation/TTL/cooldowns remain.
e5_definition.gate_scope: Only early_reversal strategy: RSI and closed5m15m trend gates executed for explanation, not mandatory; original failures retained in explanatory gate vector. Replace trend structure confirmation with frozen reclaim/trigger integrity only. All capture/E1 strategy gates unchanged. Existing EMA extension bound remains a hard chase check. E3 changes fixed wait only in E3 arms. No production mode/env flag.
e5_definition.geometry: Reuse existing native geometry default5m floor for new early_reversal strategy; no stop reduction or target/RR change. E4 unchanged location_check treats new nonrange strategy as structural-anchor distance (0,2] ATR1.
e5_definition.priority: Keep original capture/E1 proposals first, append E5 as distinct strategy; same-side qualified original wins existing priority, opposite qualified directions abstain. All32 arms and16 E5 contrasts, not independent sample counts.
e5_definition.identity: Dedicated early_reversal family with exact pre-sweep level source hash plus sweep source hash; first reclaim trigger frozen at discovery; not proximity matched to other strategy families.
e5_definition.explanatory: Retain raw failed/passed context/RSI results,5/15m returns and sampledRSI; stratify countertrend/false reclaim. No tuning from reused outcomes.
